Hold tile/floor/draw-layer/timing constants and the Proto opcode enum. Cited as data first, not as assets.

inspiration: Sprite sheets are addressed by one formula over animation frame, pattern X/Y/Z, layer and cell size (modules/thingtype.ts getSpriteIndex, line 614). An artist could lay out sheets on that grid.

The world is a 32 px tile grid stacked as floors, with a sea-level floor and an underground band (modules/constants/const.ts, Otc block). Our zone depth bands could borrow the sea line and deep band idea.
Draw order is split into named layers: ground, borders, bottom, items, creatures, effects, missiles, texts (modules/constants/const.ts, DrawFlags). Useful model for camera and VFX sort order.

Speech-style floating text stays up longer for longer lines, with a minimum and a width cap (modules/constants/const.ts block near ANIMATED_TEXT_DURATION). A fade-and-float bubble can be built on the same idea.
Character look is a set of slots (head, body, legs, feet, mount) on an outfit object (modules/outfit.ts). Setters are stubbed, but the slot model is clear.
Effects step through a per-frame animation phase that clamps at the last frame and wraps the pattern offset (modules/effect.ts drawEffect). Useful for spell and impact VFX timing.
Dialog look is a near-transparent light panel with a thin dark border (index.html inline style for .ui-dialog). A simple HUD panel idea for hud-ui.

briefs.label: Layered depth band zone
briefs.why: Zones read as depth when a sea-level line and a deep band sit in the same vertical stack; the player feels the drop.
briefs.keep: a visible sea line, a clear underground band, a fixed number of floors per zone
briefs.change: our own palette and ground textures, a different floor count and step size, zone-specific fog instead of plain bands

briefs.label: Fade-and-float speech bubble
briefs.why: Short text that rises and fades, with duration scaling to line length, gives a readable chat without a log window.
briefs.keep: duration scales with length, a minimum on-screen time, a width cap that wraps the text
briefs.change: our bubble shape (rounded tag, not a plain box), a slower rise, a small icon on the speaker's side

briefs.label: Modular slot outfit
briefs.why: A character reads as unique when head, body, legs, feet and a mount are separate slots that can be swapped and recoloured.
briefs.keep: five slots (head, body, legs, feet, mount), separate colour per slot, swap without rebuilding the character
briefs.change: our own silhouette set and proportions, slot names that match our armour lanes, a colour ramp per material rather than per slot

briefs.label: Looping effect frame cycle
briefs.why: A spell or impact that plays a short frame cycle, then holds on the last frame, reads as a clean hit without a timer bug.
briefs.keep: phase clamped at the last frame, pattern offset wraps around for direction, one frame cycle per effect
briefs.change: our own frame count and easing curve, a glow pass on top, a sound cue on frame one

briefs.label: Translucent HUD panel
briefs.why: A pale, see-through panel with a thin border lets the game world show through the HUD.
briefs.keep: semi-transparent light panel, thin dark edge, panel sits over the world rather than a solid box
briefs.change: our own panel tint and corner shape, a stronger edge for phone legibility at 375 wide, a tab row on the top edge
